sloka: रोमपादम् उवाच इदम् सह अमात्यः पुरोहितः ।उपायो निरपायो अयम् अस्माभिः अभिचिन्तितः ॥१-१०-२॥
transliteration: romapādam uvāca idam saha amātyaḥ purohitaḥ ।upāyo nirapāyo ayam asmābhiḥ abhicintitaḥ ॥1-10-2॥

translations.english: The priest accompanied by ministers said to Romapada, "We have thought over a plan which will never fail."
translations.hindi: आपके सन्तान के बारे में भगवा त्कु यों । न्‌ सनकुमार ने ऋषियों से यह कथा कही थी
